options.content:
### Entity Detail — Session / Prompt
Scope is a **session**: set **Session** to investigate the whole run. Optionally set **Prompt** to narrow every panel to a single prompt turn. The summary stats and canary signals at the top tell the story; the **Prompt Activity** table lets you drill into a single prompt without typing IDs; **Session Traces** jumps you to the matching trace. Raw event rows live in the collapsed row at the bottom.

_Note: this stack has a single user (log `user_email` is always `unknown`), so there is no User filter. `api_error` is not emitted by this build — reliability is tracked via tool failures (`tool_result | success=false`) instead._

panels.title: Prompt Count

targets.expr: count(sum by (prompt_id) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | prompt_id =~ ".+" [$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.description: Distinct prompt IDs in the current session scope (narrows to 1 when a Prompt is selected).

panels.title: Total Cost

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.description: Spend (api_request cost_usd) across the scoped session/prompt and selected models.

panels.title: Total Tokens

targets.expr: (sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | unwrap input_tokens [$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | unwrap output_tokens [$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.description: Input + output tokens on api_request events. Each sum is guarded with or vector(0) so a missing stream does not blank the card.

panels.title: API Calls

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.description: Count of api_request events in scope.

panels.title: Tool Executions

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | tool_name=~"$tool_name" | event_name = `tool_result` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.description: Count of tool_result events in scope.

panels.title: Tool Failure Rate

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | tool_name=~"$tool_name" | event_name = `tool_result` | success = `false` [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | tool_name=~"$tool_name" | event_name = `tool_result` [$__range])) * 100) or vector(0)

panels.description: Share of tool_result events with success=false (baseline ≈ 2.6%). This is the real reliability signal; api_error is not emitted by this build.

panels.title: Read per Edit/Write

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | event_name = `tool_result` | tool_name = `Read` [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | event_name = `tool_result` | tool_name =~ `Edit|Write` [$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.description: Read vs Edit/Write ratio. Low values suggest editing before enough reading.

panels.title: Write Share

targets.expr: ((sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | event_name = `tool_result` | tool_name = `Write` [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | event_name = `tool_result` | tool_name =~ `Edit|Write` [$__range]))) * 100) or vector(0)

panels.description: Share of edit operations that are full-file Write (vs surgical Edit). A high Write share can indicate rewrite-heavy behavior.

panels.title: Tool Success Rate

targets.expr: ((sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | tool_name=~"$tool_name" | event_name = `tool_result` | success = `true` [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | tool_name=~"$tool_name" | event_name = `tool_result` [$__range]))) * 100) or vector(0)

panels.description: Share of tool_result events with success=true (the inverse of the failure rate; baseline ≈ 97%).

panels.title: Cache Hit Efficiency

targets.expr: (sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__range])) / (sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | unwrap input_tokens [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | unwrap cache_creation_tokens [$__range]))) * 100) or vector(0)

panels.description: cache_read / (cache_read + input + cache_creation) tokens. A drop means the prompt cache is underused, inflating cost and latency.
